scope: Proposition 7.2 (Capture on a plateau) of the manuscript “Almost-everywhere Fourier convergence in L log L” (preprints/Almost-everywhere-Fourier-convergence-in-L-log-L-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 075 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9a77d41e5b9b9beb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 46. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In the finite procedure, for every plateau, allowed level, and criterion above, there is a cumulative finite list D of integers, initially empty, whose appends are prescribed at jumping post states, such that, after the appends at p, u high and the jump not bad =⇒ |u − v||p| ≤ poly(1 + |D|, d1, 1/b) for some v ∈ [D], [D] = {︄ ∑︂ n∈D ηnn : ηn ∈ {0, 1, −1} }︄ , EUe |D|final ≤ Cd1b−C . (7.6) The construction is independent of the caps used below. The bad-edge charge at p and level b is ep,b1{p bad at level b}. Its global live sum, with weights U(p)αe, is O(d) when one scalar level is selected predictably at each piece, and O(poly(h)(h + log d)) when all main levels are summed. The local one-scalar-level charge is O(d1) under Ue. Forward from a live post state the conditional expected number of bad jumps at a fixed main level is at most d poly(h). For each deterministic dyadic Dmax ≥ 1, the scheme stopped when |D| > Dmax admits snapshots with expected number poly(Dmax, d1, 1/b). A snapshot at level b stores at most ⌈ekb/2 ⌉ main repre- sentatives, or exp(C(d1 + log(1/b))) scalar representatives. Each birth and its list are determined by the spatial prefix before its birth jump. At a jump p, call a high integer u activated when some v ∈ [D] satisfies |u − v||p| ≤ σ in the main case, or |u − v||p| ≤ c8b4 in the scalar case, for a sufficiently small fixed c8 > 0. At activation its chosen representative s has, for the remainder of that plateau, a fixed decomposition u = s + n + a′, ∆A(n) ≤ rsep, |a′||pact| ≤ Cσ, main, u = s + a′, |a′||pact| ≤ c1b4, scalar, where pact is the activation node and c1 can be made a sufficiently small absolute constant. Before first activation, all non-bad high jumps for this u lie in a single block of at most Hb = C log(CDmaxd1/b) + C log(1/σ) consecutive depths, as long as the cap is not breached. The construction does not use sampled side or auxiliary values on an output path.
